env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos run ./ok
stdout '^ok$'
! logos build ./...
stderr 'cannot use'

logos build -o $WORK/ok$GOEXE ./okmain

logos run ./viewread
stdout '^20 1 40 3 10 4$'
! logos build -o $WORK/vw$GOEXE ./viewwrite
stderr 'const_view_mutation\] cannot assign field through const view v'
! logos build -o $WORK/pw$GOEXE ./pviewwrite
stderr 'const_view_mutation\] cannot assign field through const view p'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/tuplenames

go 1.27

-- p/p.lgo --
package p

func Show(t (x int64, err error)) string {
	return "ok"
}

type Pair (id int, n int)

var Xs [](id int, n int) = [](id int, n int){(1, 10), (2, 20)}

var Ps []Pair = []Pair{(3, 30), (4, 40)}

func View() const [](id int, n int) { return Xs }

func PView() const []Pair { return Ps }

-- main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/tuplenames/p"

func main() {
	var v (id int64, err error) = (1, nil)
	println(p.Show(v))
}

-- okmain/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/tuplenames/p"

func main() {
	var v (x int64, err error) = (1, nil)
	println(p.Show(v))
}

-- ok/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/tuplenames/p"
)

func main() {
	var w (x int64, err error) = (3, nil)
	fmt.Println(p.Show(w))
}

-- viewread/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/tuplenames/p"
)

func main() {
	v := p.View()
	q := p.PView()
	fmt.Println(v[1].n, v[0].id, q[1].n, q[0].id, p.Xs[0].n, p.Ps[1].id)
}

-- viewwrite/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/tuplenames/p"

func main() {
	v := p.View()
	v[0].n = 9
}

-- pviewwrite/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/tuplenames/p"

func main() {
	p := p.PView()
	p[1].id = 9
}
